title: Non-Periodic Chirped Stack for Broad Stopband Suppression
scientific_hypothesis: A non-periodic chirped layer thickness distribution can achieve wider and deeper stopband suppression in both 1400-1500 nm and 1600-1700 nm bands compared to quarter-wave periodic stacks, while maintaining a transmission peak at 1550 nm.
design_principle: Chirped multilayer structures vary layer optical thicknesses gradually across the stack, creating multiple overlapping reflection bands that merge into a broader stopband. This approach is motivated by fabrication error analysis showing non-periodic designs can achieve unique spectral properties not accessible with periodic quarter-wave stacks.
proposed_topology: Air | [ta2o5/sio2]_7 with chirped thicknesses | ta2o5(cavity) | [sio2/ta2o5]_7 with chirped thicknesses | Fused Silica substrate
design_variables: individual layer thicknesses in nm for all 15 layers with no periodicity constraint
chirp rate parameter for thickness gradient across mirror stacks
manufacturing_considerations: chirped design requires precise thickness control for each layer
theory_basis: Broadband stopband engineering through thickness grading
expected_advantages: Wider stopband coverage than quarter-wave stacks
Can tailor stopband shape independently on each side
May achieve deeper suppression with same layer count
known_risks: More complex optimization landscape may converge slower
Manufacturing tolerance may be tighter than periodic designs
Risk of splitting the passband if chirp is too aggressive
execution_request_english: Design a non-periodic chirped narrowband bandpass filter for 1550 nm LiDAR reception. Incident medium is air. Substrate is Fused Silica. Use only Ta2O5 (Gao) (high index) and SiO2 (Lemarchand) (low index) materials. Stack topology: Air | Ta2O5 (Gao) | SiO2 (Lemarchand) | Ta2O5 (Gao) | SiO2 (Lemarchand) | Ta2O5 (Gao) | SiO2 (Lemarchand) | Ta2O5 (Gao) | SiO2 (Lemarchand) | Ta2O5 (Gao) | SiO2 (Lemarchand) | Ta2O5 (Gao) | SiO2 (Lemarchand) | Ta2O5 (Gao) | SiO2 (Lemarchand) | Ta2O5 (Gao)(cavity) | SiO2 (Lemarchand) | Ta2O5 (Gao) | SiO2 (Lemarchand) | Ta2O5 (Gao) | SiO2 (Lemarchand) | Ta2O5 (Gao) | SiO2 (Lemarchand) | Ta2O5 (Gao) | SiO2 (Lemarchand) | Ta2O5 (Gao) | SiO2 (Lemarchand) | Ta2O5 (Gao) | SiO2 (Lemarchand) | Fused Silica. This is 15 layers total (7 pairs on each side plus one cavity layer). Optimize all individual layer thicknesses in nanometers with no periodicity constraint. Target wavelength is 1550 nm at normal incidence. Maximize transmittance at 1550 nm with soft target ≥0.95. Minimize transmittance in 1400-1500 nm and 1600-1700 nm bands. Total layers must not exceed 30.
